prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Precise-object-edit. Edit target: two Ruta puppet parts shown side by side, arm-left then sleeveless torso. Remove ONLY the TWO red-cross marks: the red cross on the upper sleeve of left part and red cross at upper-left shoulder of right part. Fill those small cross areas with the same pale felt fabric already surrounding them. Preserve every other part of both images, their positions, contours, mitten, cuff, scarf STRIPES (keep stripes red), strap, side panels, palette, proportions. Two isolated parts in same row. No new details. Transparent background. The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours.
notes: Remove duplicate front viewer-left sleeve cross and hidden duplicate torso cross with local registered patches only; retain viewer-right shoulder cross. All pixels elsewhere unchanged.
